form.title: Form & Structure: Have Got
form.content: Subject + have got / has got + noun. Negative: haven't got / hasn't got. Question: Have/Has + subject + got...?

controlledPractice.question: Question form: '___ she got a sister?'
controlledPractice.explanation: He/she/it uses 'has got'; the question inverts to 'Has she got…?'

controlledPractice.question: Past tense of 'have got'?
controlledPractice.explanation: 'Have got' has no separate past form · just use 'had'.
